data_fields.name: mapPt1, mapPt2 (map image coordinates)
data_fields.donor_constant: read per area from ARE Map struct (values not read)

data_fields.name: worldPt1, worldPt2 (world coordinates)
data_fields.donor_constant: read per area from ARE Map struct (values not read)

best_idea: Store each zone's minimap as two map points and the same two world points, fit a linear map per axis, and centre the party's point, so no zone needs hand-tuned offsets.
decision_why: The per-zone two-point calibration is the right shape for zones as data; take it, fix the zero-span division and the unguarded HUD path, and do not copy the 435/256 numbers.
acceptance: A zone whose two world points share an X or Y is rejected at load with a logged error, and at 375 wide the minimap dot stays on the party while walking and the arrow turns with the camera while the party stands still (unit test on worldToMap for north 0 and 3, plus a visual check).
